scenes.headline: Kingston isn't Jamaica's best-yielding parish.
scenes.vo: Kingston isn't Jamaica's best-yielding parish. Here's who beats it.

scenes.title: Gross long-let yield, 2-bed
scenes.note: Source: APG analysis of live listings, Oct 2026. Medians, 2-bed homes. Gross yield = 12 x median rent / median price, before costs.
scenes.vo: We ranked eight parishes by gross yield on a typical two-bed. Manchester leads at six and a half percent. Trelawny's right behind.

scenes.big: £140k to buy. £751 a month in rent.
body: Lower entry price, rents that hold up. That's where the yield comes from.
scenes.vo: A Manchester two-bed costs about a hundred and forty thousand pounds, or a hundred and eighty-five thousand dollars, and rents for around seven fifty a month.

body: Fees, tax, voids and maintenance all come off next.
scenes.vo: But that's gross. Fees, tax and empty months come off next.
